description.value: Forested riverside park northwest of Port Alberni where thousands of Pacific salmon stage below Stamp Falls before climbing the fish ladders each fall — one of Vancouver Island's most accessible wildlife spectacles for a touring cyclist. Hiking trails follow the river, black bears frequent the area during the run, and no swimming is permitted due to strong currents.

address.value: Beaver Creek Road, Port Alberni, BC
